correctness.rationale: For every m the cluster-size pair identity counts exactly the two deletion types; ordinary deletion strictly adds an edge after graph isomorphism. For m=3, q3=p+p²-p³ yields the displayed difference p(2p³-5p²+p+1)/3. Substitution t=p/(1-p) reduces f to 1+4t-t³; Descartes signs and endpoints force a unique root and complete classification. Finite exact verification enumerates 412 configurations and passes 32 assertions; no finite simulation is substituted for proof.

They do not directly imply the precise global minimizer and unique algebraic boundary for independent bond transmission on the specified seven-vertex graph. The broad qualitative observation that bridges may matter is not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The two-clique degree-two-gateway family is a natural minimal benchmark for conflict between local degree and intercommunity connectivity. Strict domination removes all other vaccines; the first switch has an exact unique algebraic boundary, and the conflict exists for every larger pair of equal cliques. This is a nonroutine motivated classification, not a generic renaming of a known table or an arbitrary numeral.
